■Stage Direction
[Lingering note] About 2 seconds of silence (give the impression she was listening quietly without being shaken)

Tomorrow is the discipline-specific meet, after all.
You'll be running against Bourbon-san again, so you'd like to make adjustments, correct?
Hah, hah, hah.

She never blamed herself excessively for coming up short.
And during yesterday's solo training—

W-What's with this all of a sudden?!
Jeez, you're... you're gonna make me blush~!

And now they head into the fourth corner!
Mihono Bourbon moves into second on the outside! Who will make the first move?!

I can't really explain it well, but it was like...
this fiery *fwoosh* inside of me!
Taaaahhhhh!!

Mihono Bourbon's run in the last mock race was incredible!
She won by a massive margin, so I'm looking forward to seeing her today too.
Well, guess that's how it goes! Can I try it again tomorrow?

I watched as she candidly accepted feedback
from a fellow Umamusume who could easily be called her rival.

In that sense, competing with a flat, even-keeled attitude
like Machikane Tannhauser's is usually difficult.
Haaaaahhh!
Mihono Bourbon makes her move! Mihono Bourbon pulls ahead with under 200 to go!
Haaah!!
(Wh-What is with that acceleration~?! —Still, even so!)

Oh, looks like Machikane Tannhauser is running too.
If I remember right, she couldn't stretch out last time and had kind of a mediocre run?

...Yeah. Ehehe, truth be told,
I felt like I managed to grow a little today too!

And... Machikane Tannhauser! She took fourth, but showed sharp closing speed
with a great final surge! Definitely one to keep an eye on from now on~

Mm-hmm, got it, got it!
Thank you!
If she can remain this steadfastly 'ordinary,' however, that changes everything.

...Mun. True, last time wasn't so great.
Which is all the more reason to give it my very best today~! Ei, ei, mun!

Without feeling weighed down, she converted their words into strength.
Her ordinariness was supporting her growth far more than I had imagined.

Let's give it our all today too!
With that said, I'm heading out to warm up~!
(All right, time to accelerate from here and catch Bourbon-san!)

Remembering how you told me 'I'm looking forward to your future'
the other day made my heart swell up like *woooah*!

...Meeting you might've been
a way bigger stroke of luck than I ever thought. ...Hehe.

Machikane Tannhauser is always 'ordinary.' Once I realized that,
it stood out to me even more. For instance, during training the other day—

Maintaining an 'ordinary' attitude and persevering through effort no matter what happens
is a tremendous quality that works immensely in her favor when developing as a racer.

The pack gives chase! Will they catch her, or will she hold them off?!
And yet, there she goes—Mihono Bourbon crosses the wire in first!
"I'm looking forward to seeing what you accomplish in the future."

(—That doesn't matter!
I don't want anything less than first place either!)
"I'm looking forward to seeing what you accomplish in the future."

Man... I still didn't quite make it today either.
I totally won the 'Long Way to Go Award' again, didn't I?

Indeed...
Your acceleration after clearing the final corner seems to fall slightly short.
Man, Mihono Bourbon really is incredible, huh!

I'm counting on you from here on out.
So with that said... here, we can split it!

*wheeze, gasp, pant*~ Man, I know I've gotta build up
my stamina, but my body just isn't keeping up at all~

The racing world is harsh. It demands extraordinary running ability, tenacity,
drive, and a generous dose of good luck.
The leader remains Mihono Bourbon—just 100 meters to go!

*phew, pant, gasp*~~...
...Ehehe.

Mihono Bourbon holds second place.
Machikane Tannhauser is in fifth as they blow past the 600-meter mark!

All runners are loaded in the gates.
Turf 1600m—and they're off!

Eee!~
Getting treated even though I came in fourth?!

—And then came the day of the discipline-specific meet. Turf 1600m mile.
The Umamusume drawing the most attention was, by a landslide, Mihono Bourbon.

I'm baaack~!
Now then, which routine were we starting with today again?
